blocks.text: Runbook: electric pallet jack on dock and pick aisles

This is the working cut for PCF-1240 on December 12, 2023. Ben Crowe asked for a written bound after the current path (Verbal pre-op, cards missing, horn tape leftover) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host dock.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on run a jack with a dead horn to finish a wave, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Pre-op card on the cage board. Horn, brake, forks, battery. No riders. Red-tag a dead horn; do not 'just this trip.' I am not restating a hallway yes. run a jack with a dead horn to finish a wave is out because November 30 near-miss at cross-aisle 4. Horn was taped. Marcus stopped the jack in writing. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: jacks=18, miss=1, aisle=4, cards=18, weeks=2, riders=0, battery=22.4, trips=1. Sibling tickets PCF-RB-2023-031 and PCF-1240-SAF. I will not reopen run a jack with a dead horn to finish a wave in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: aisle-b2.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (03): refuse on run a jack with a dead horn to finish a wave, lock is pre-op card, no riders, red-tag dead horn. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-RB-2023-031.
If the horn is dead I do not take the jack. I take a walk to the cage.

What a skeptical lead would try first on dock.pinecrest.internal: the path Ben Crowe actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on equip.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
